items.zh: 外面雨这么大，你带伞了吗？
items.scene: 暴雨天在公司楼门口问没带伞的同事

answers.en: It's pouring out — did you bring an umbrella?
answers.note: 先感叹雨势再问，带关心意味，适合看到对方准备冲进雨里时用。

answers.en: You got an umbrella? It's really coming down.
answers.note: You got 省略 Do，非常口语；coming down 指雨下得猛，适合熟人之间随口问。

answers.en: Do you have an umbrella? It's raining pretty hard out there.
answers.note: 标准问法，语气平和，适合关系一般或想顺便把自己的伞借出去时。

items.zh: 这雨下到什么时候啊？我外卖都凉了。
items.scene: 加班时在办公室等外卖，雨一直没停

answers.en: How long is this rain supposed to last? My takeout's getting cold.
answers.note: 用 be supposed to 问预报安排，语气偏无奈，适合边等边抱怨。

answers.en: When's it gonna stop raining? My food's already cold.
answers.note: gonna 和 already 都很口语，重点在催促雨停，适合跟熟人发牢骚。

answers.en: Is it supposed to keep raining? My takeout's cold now.
answers.note: 用 keep raining 强调没完没了，疑问更轻，适合随口确认天气。

items.zh: 刚才是不是下冰雹了？我听见窗户一直响。
items.scene: 傍晚在客厅听见窗户响，问家人

answers.en: Was that hail just now? I kept hearing it hit the window.
answers.note: 用 Was that 确认刚发生的事，画面感强，适合听见动静但没亲眼看到时。

answers.en: Did it hail? I heard something pounding on the windows.
answers.note: 直接问有没有下冰雹，pounding 强调砸窗的声响，语气更惊讶。

answers.en: Were those hailstones hitting the window? It was so loud.
answers.note: 用复数 hailstones 具体指冰雹颗粒，带确认和感叹，适合声音特别大时。

items.zh: 今天怎么这么冷？我是不是穿少了。
items.scene: 早上出门在电梯里碰见邻居

answers.en: Why is it so cold today? Did I underdress?
answers.note: underdress 是穿得不够暖的正式说法，整句像自问，适合随口跟邻居搭话。

answers.en: It's freezing today — am I dressed too light?
answers.note: 先下结论再问，dressed too light 是日常说法，适合语气轻松的闲聊。

answers.en: How come it's this cold? I don't think I wore enough.
answers.note: How come 比 why 更口语，后半句自己给判断，适合熟人之间碎碎念。

items.zh: 明天降温十度，你秋裤找出来了吗？
items.scene: 晚上视频问在外地上大学的儿子

answers.en: It's dropping ten degrees tomorrow — did you dig out your long johns?
answers.note: dig out 指翻出压箱底的衣服，带调侃，适合家长轻松提醒孩子。

answers.en: Have you gotten your long johns out? It's going to be ten degrees colder tomorrow.
answers.note: 现在完成时问结果，重点是有没有找出来，语气比随口一问更认真。

answers.en: You found your long johns yet? It's gonna be ten degrees colder.
answers.note: 省略 Have，句尾 yet 表示等结果，非常口语，适合关系亲近的家人。

items.zh: 外面风好大，我就穿这件薄外套出去会不会冷？
items.scene: 出门前对着镜子问同住的室友

answers.en: It's really windy out — will this thin jacket be enough?
answers.note: 先讲天气再问够不够，语气中立，适合让对方帮你判断。

answers.en: Do you think I'll be cold in just this light jacket?
answers.note: 用 Do you think 征求看法，重点在自己会不会冷，适合拿不定主意时。

answers.en: Is this jacket too thin for this wind?
answers.note: 直接把问题落在外套上，问得更干脆，适合已经倾向换衣服时。

items.zh: 今天空气指数多少？还能出去跑步吗？
items.scene: 早上在窗边刷手机，问准备晨跑的室友

answers.en: What's the AQI today? Is it okay to go for a run?
answers.note: AQI 是空气指数的常用缩写，先问数据再问能不能跑，语气理性。

answers.en: How bad is the air today? Can I still run outside?
answers.note: How bad 预设空气不好，带担心，适合看到窗外灰蒙蒙时。

answers.en: What's the air quality like? Should I skip my run?
answers.note: 问得比较委婉，Should I 把决定交给对方，适合想听建议时。

items.zh: 雾霾这么大，窗户还开着吗？
items.scene: 下班回家看到客厅窗户还开着

answers.en: The smog's pretty bad — are the windows still open?
answers.note: 先说明雾霾再问窗，像提醒而不是质问，适合不想把话说重时。

answers.en: Is the window still open? The air's terrible out there.
answers.note: 先问再解释原因，语气直接，适合确认情况后马上关窗。

answers.en: Why are the windows open with all this smog?
answers.note: Why 开头带明显不满，像责怪家里人，适合关系亲近、说话不拘束时。

items.zh: 口罩快用完了，雾霾还得几天，要不要再买点？
items.scene: 晚上刷购物软件时问伴侣

answers.en: We're almost out of masks and the smog's sticking around — should we order more?
answers.note: sticking around 指雾霾迟迟不退，整句像一起做决定，语气务实。

answers.en: Do we need to stock up on masks? The air's supposed to stay bad for days.
answers.note: stock up 是囤货，先问需求再给预报理由，适合计划性强的对话。

answers.en: How many masks do we have left? This smog isn't going anywhere.
answers.note: 先查库存，后半句带无奈，适合已经觉得雾霾没完没了时。

items.zh: 台风明天登陆，公司会放假吗？
items.scene: 看到台风预警后在公司群里问同事

answers.en: The typhoon's making landfall tomorrow — do you think the office will close?
answers.note: make landfall 是台风登陆的新闻用语，整句偏正式，适合群里讨论。

answers.en: Are we getting the day off for the typhoon tomorrow?
answers.note: get the day off 是放假的日常说法，直接问结果，适合同事间打听。

answers.en: Think the company will shut down tomorrow because of the typhoon?
answers.note: 省略 Do you，Think 开头很口语，shut down 强调停工，适合熟同事。

items.zh: 台风要来了，家里水和泡面够吗？
items.scene: 台风前一天在超市打电话问伴侣

answers.en: The typhoon's coming — do we have enough water and instant noodles at home?
answers.note: 逐项确认家里的东西，语气平稳，适合在超市边看货架边问。

answers.en: Should we stock up before the typhoon hits? We're low on water.
answers.note: 用 Should we 提议囤货，并说明水不多了，适合主动张罗的人。

answers.en: Are we good on water and instant noodles for the typhoon?
answers.note: Are we good on 是口语里确认库存的说法，简短利落，适合赶时间时。

items.zh: 地铁会因为台风停运吗？我明天还得上班。
items.scene: 台风前夜在家庭群里问上班族表姐

answers.en: Will the subway shut down because of the typhoon? I still have to go to work tomorrow.
answers.note: 用 will 直接问停运，后半句说明自己的难处，语气着急。

answers.en: Are they gonna suspend subway service tomorrow? I can't miss work.
answers.note: suspend service 像新闻里的正式说法，gonna 又拉回口语，适合群里转消息。

answers.en: Any word on the subway closing for the typhoon? I've still got to get to the office.
answers.note: Any word on 是打听消息的随口问法，适合还没看到官方通知时。

items.zh: 空调开这么低，你外套借我穿一下行吗？
items.scene: 夏天在工位冻得发抖，问旁边同事

answers.en: They've got the AC blasting in here — could I borrow your jacket for a bit?
answers.note: blasting 强调空调开得猛，could I 客气，适合跟不太熟的同事开口。

answers.en: Is it just me, or is it freezing in here? Can I borrow your jacket?
answers.note: Is it just me 先找共鸣再借衣服，语气轻松，适合关系不错的同事。

answers.en: Mind if I borrow your jacket? It's like an icebox in this office.
answers.note: Mind if 是随口请求，icebox 夸张比喻，适合熟人之间带点玩笑。

items.zh: 明天面试穿什么？这天看着要下雨。
items.scene: 晚上在衣柜前问室友第二天穿什么

answers.en: What should I wear to the interview tomorrow? It looks like rain.
answers.note: 标准征求建议，天气只作补充，适合还没想好整体搭配时。

answers.en: Do I need a suit for tomorrow, or is that too much if it rains?
answers.note: 用 or 摆出两个选择，too much 指太正式，适合在正装和便装间犹豫。

answers.en: What's the move for tomorrow — dress up or plan around the rain?
answers.note: What's the move 很口语，plan around 指按天气安排，适合和熟人快速商量。

items.zh: 天气预报说明天有雨，你信吗？
items.scene: 晚饭后窝在沙发上问伴侣

answers.en: The forecast says rain tomorrow — do you buy it?
answers.note: buy it 在这里是相信的意思，带点调侃，适合预报经常不准时。

answers.en: They're calling for rain tomorrow. Think it'll actually happen?
answers.note: be calling for 是预报会下雨的常见说法，actually 表示怀疑。

answers.en: Is it supposed to rain tomorrow? I don't trust the forecast.
answers.note: 先按常规问天气，再补一句不信任，语气最直白，适合随口抱怨。

items.zh: 周末天气怎么样？还适合去爬山吗？
items.scene: 周四午休时问想约爬山的朋友

answers.en: What's the forecast for the weekend? Good enough for a hike?
answers.note: 先问预报再用省略句追问，节奏快，适合午休时简短商量。

answers.en: How's the weather looking for Saturday? Can we still do the hike?
answers.note: be looking 是口语里问天气走势的说法，can we still 带不确定。

answers.en: Is it supposed to be nice this weekend? I was thinking about hiking.
answers.note: 先问天气好不好，再说自己的打算，语气最委婉，适合不想强求对方。

items.zh: 预报说有大雪，高铁会不会停运？
items.scene: 出差前一天在办公室问同行的同事

answers.en: The forecast says heavy snow — do you think the high-speed train will be canceled?
answers.note: high-speed train 直指高铁，整句偏中性，适合正式确认行程。

answers.en: Will the bullet train still run with all this snow coming?
answers.note: bullet train 是美式口语里常见的高铁说法，still 强调还能不能开。

answers.en: Are they expecting delays tomorrow with the snow?
answers.note: 不问停运而问晚点，expecting delays 更像出行前的实际考虑，语气冷静。

items.zh: 你最喜欢哪个季节？我觉得秋天太短了。
items.scene: 秋天散步时和朋友聊起喜欢的季节

answers.en: What's your favorite season? I feel like fall's way too short.
answers.note: 直接问喜好再补自己的感受，way too 很口语，适合边走边聊。

answers.en: Which season do you like best? Fall never lasts long enough for me.
answers.note: like best 比 favorite 稍具体，后半句带遗憾，适合认真聊喜好。

answers.en: Are you more of a summer person or a fall person? I wish fall lasted longer.
answers.note: a ... person 是口语里说偏好的说法，选择问法更轻松。

items.zh: 这儿是不是只有冬夏，没有春天？
items.scene: 换季时在楼下和邻居闲聊

answers.en: Does it feel like we only get winter and summer here, with no spring?
answers.note: 用 Does it feel like 引出共同感受，语气温和，适合和邻居闲聊。

answers.en: Is it just me, or did we skip spring this year?
answers.note: Is it just me 是找认同的固定说法，skip spring 很形象，语气随意。

answers.en: Where did spring go? It feels like it went straight from winter to summer.
answers.note: Where did spring go 是半开玩笑的感叹，画面感强，适合熟人聊天。

items.zh: 屋里怎么这么潮？除湿机放哪了？
items.scene: 梅雨季下班回家，问先到的室友

answers.en: Why is it so humid in here? Where's the dehumidifier?
answers.note: 两个短问句连用，先问原因再找东西，语气直接，适合刚进门时。

answers.en: It's so muggy inside — where did we put the dehumidifier?
answers.note: muggy 指闷热潮湿，where did we put 更口语，适合一起住的熟人。

answers.en: Did someone turn off the dehumidifier? It feels like a sauna in here.
answers.note: 用 Did someone 带一点责怪，sauna 是夸张比喻，适合潮得难受时。

items.zh: 衣服晾了三天还湿的，这湿度正常吗？
items.scene: 梅雨季在阳台收衣服时问室友

answers.en: My clothes have been hanging for three days and they're still damp — is this normal?
answers.note: 先说事实再问是否正常，damp 指没干透，语气无奈，适合抱怨天气。

answers.en: Is it normal for laundry to stay wet for three days in this humidity?
answers.note: 用 Is it normal for 把问题一般化，语气更理性，像在确认气候。

answers.en: Does it usually stay this humid? My clothes won't dry.
answers.note: 先问当地常态再补自己的麻烦，适合刚搬来、不熟悉气候时。

items.zh: 今天太阳这么大，你涂防晒了吗？
items.scene: 出门前在玄关问正在穿鞋的室友

answers.en: The sun's really strong today — did you put on sunscreen?
answers.note: 先说太阳强再问，像提醒，语气自然，适合一起出门前。

answers.en: Did you put sunscreen on? That sun is intense.
answers.note: 先问再感叹，重点在防晒有没有做，intense 比 strong 更强调。

answers.en: You got sunscreen on? It's blazing out there.
answers.note: 省略 Do，blazing 形容太阳毒辣，非常口语，适合熟人之间。

items.zh: 被子晒外面了吗？这太阳下午应该能干。
items.scene: 周末早上在阳台问正在做家务的家人

answers.en: Did you hang the blankets outside? With this sun, they should be dry by the afternoon.
answers.note: 先确认有没有晒，再用太阳判断能干，语气平和，适合早上问安排。

answers.en: Are the blankets out on the line? This sun'll dry them by this afternoon.
answers.note: on the line 指晾在绳上，'ll 缩写更口语，重点在现在晒没晒出去。

answers.en: Should we put the blankets out? They'd dry fast in this sun.
answers.note: 用 Should we 提建议，而不是确认已做，适合还没动手时。

items.zh: 暖气怎么还没来？物业说几号供暖了吗？
items.scene: 十一月北方家里还没来暖气，问室友

answers.en: Why isn't the heat on yet? Did the building say when it starts?
answers.note: heat 是美式英语里暖气的常用说法，先抱怨再问通知，语气着急。

answers.en: When's the heat supposed to come on? It's freezing in here.
answers.note: be supposed to 问原定时间，后半句强调家里冷，适合催促物业前。

answers.en: Did management give a date for the heat? I'm tired of bundling up indoors.
answers.note: management 指物业，bundle up 是裹厚衣服，带抱怨，适合等得不耐烦时。

items.zh: 屋里暖气太足了，你不觉得干吗？
items.scene: 冬天在暖气很足的朋友家做客

answers.en: The heat's really cranked up in here — don't you find it dry?
answers.note: cranked up 指暖气开得很大，don't you 寻求认同，语气客气。

answers.en: Isn't it super dry with the heat this high?
answers.note: 否定疑问句期待对方同意，super dry 很口语，适合熟人之间。

answers.en: It's so dry in here — is your heat always this high?
answers.note: 先陈述感受再问对方习惯，暗含一点惊讶，适合做客时半开玩笑。
